stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, Asia Grocery Distribution Limited is a key player in the sourcing and distribution of food and beverage items throughout Hong Kong. Its comprehensive product portfolio includes staple commodities like rice, wheat flour, noodles, edible oils, sugar, and salt. The company also offers a wide selection of packaged foods, from preserved, canned, and frozen meats and vegetables to various snacks and ready-to-eat meals. Beyond groceries, they supply an array of kitchen and hygiene products, such as food wraps (e.g., cling film, baking sheets, foil), cleaning supplies (detergents, bleaches, liquid soaps), general household goods (tissue paper, toothpicks, towels), and personal protective gear (face masks, gloves). Complementing these are diverse sauces, condiments, dairy products, eggs, and a curated range of beverages and wines. Asia Grocery Distribution also extends its services to include product procurement, custom repackaging, rigorous quality assurance, secure warehousing, efficient logistics, and various other value-added solutions. Their extensive customer base spans restaurants, institutional food service providers, hotels, private clubs, food processors, and wholesalers. Founded in 1975 and headquartered in Kowloon, Hong Kong, the company operates as a subsidiary of Sky Alpha Investments Limited.
